title: Ay ali teri tanhaiyan
body:
aaj tak koi samjha kahan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan
bas faqat hai teri raazdan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
jagmagati na tauheed mein
gar simat'ti na tauheed mein
aakhirash phir simat'ti kahan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
poochti hai salooni yehi
hai koi ilm kash hai koi
haye koi nahi tha wahan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa koi salam o kalam
jab nahi hai jawab e salam
uff ye tauqeer e ilm al-amaan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahi hai jo shaam o sahar
fatema teri tanhaai par
fatema par hai girya kuna
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis ko yaara kare guftagu
goongti hai yahan sirf hoo
bolti hai khuda ki zaban
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ibtida inteha kibriya
ambiya aulia ausiya
sab hai chup bolti hai jahan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam ba dam pae ba pae jaa baja
keh rahi hai ye kun ki sada
kaadh leti hai khud se jahan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaat e shahid mein mash'hood mein
yan wajood aur maujood mein
kam se kam hai fasl e kamaan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
husn ki deed ki ain tak
jalwa e qaaba qausain tak
haan bas ek parda e darmiyan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
author: Ahmed Naved
